owner: Progatik root; new isolated validation tool, Statistics sources remain read-only

Validation.acceptance: every cohort complete and error-free; Master clean/full gain; 99percent mean CI entirely target plus-or-minus0.2; adjacent mean times strictly decreasing with level; actual outcome patterns diverse for juniorlevels

ConstantAudit.counts: 200 each of all50, same first held-out seeds; separate paired camera audit, no independence claim across cameras
ConstantAudit.acceptance: all outcomes/errors/eliminations retained; Master clean finish; no target-mean criterion applied to censored cohorts

statistics.method: existing Stats with expectedN200/400/800, sample SD n-1, conservative two-sided99percent tCritical2.601 for all n>=200
statistics.missingTerminal: all corresponding aggregates and CI null; never silently reduce n
statistics.terminalQualityFailure: actual terminal time/counts included, but cohort acceptance fails
statistics.boundary: abs(mean-target)+halfWidth<=0.2 with explicit numeric tolerance<=1e-9 seconds; crossing boundary is INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS
statistics.diversity: retain distinct physical hit/success/fullfinish patterns and saved intention patterns; do not enforce per-race success quotas

publication.config: safe unique named config; phase and camera exact, no runtime seed/parameter overrides; preplan bytes must match published hash
publication.parameters: describe actual frozen Core difficulty factory at seed0 for all50, publish exact canonical settings table; pCollect=q, Master1/0, infer and verify one shared junior-level k per pair without clamping
publication.snapshots: all Core, shared Statistics C# sources, new tool/protocol/config/preplan; Release DLL, canonical table/schedule, hashes and fresh tracked manifest; read-only publication
publication.guards: CreateNew outputs and permanent claim, source checks before/after publish; exact assembly/config/table/schedule/published-file hashes before/after cohort
publication.failure: retain accumulated outcomes and explicit unrun IDs; postrun verification failure never becomes zero-case setup result
publication.execution: no publication or physical cohort before root technical GO; final validation only after calibration/source/table freeze

report: raw allcase facts/intents/errors plus summary CI/targets/order/diversity/eliminations, exact source/assembly/config/table/schedule hashes, all unrun IDs; phase-aware labels, no Training/exploratory flags mislabelled as validation acceptance
